input.answer: The New Housing Price Index for Canada (Total, house and land) was 120.2 in September 2026 (index, December 2016=100). August 2026 was 120.4, so the index fell 0.2 points (120.2 − 120.4), about −0.2% (−0.2/120.4 = −0.17%).
